clauses.title: The snapshot classifies CodeRabbit's review state
Readiness reads the classification and reports it as observed
requires: An external review provider's state (CL-D92) is reported as observed, never waited for.

clauses.title: CL-D92 records the classification rule
clauses.section: ## CL-D92 — The snapshot classifies CodeRabbit's review state
requires: Reading CodeRabbit from an empty suite, or from anything but this classification, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The CL-D92 fixtures drive the classification
requires: Issue #193 an empty queued suite beside a success status is a completed CodeRabbit review
Issue #193 an empty suite alone detects no provider

clauses.title: The aggregate alarm value is the one the suites assert
